title: Why I Bought More Netflix Stock Near 52 Week Lows | NFLX Stock Analysis
creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
summary: Parkevtate Vosianc explains adding to Netflix near the 52-week low ~$67: record 30.25% operating margin, ROIC 3x WACC, fwd P/E 17.7, FV $115 (+71% upside). Biggest risk is shifting consumer preference toward short-form content; levers include re-reporting subscriber counts and a free ad-supported tier. Largest portfolio position, interested in adding more.

calls.thesis: Bought more near the 52-week low ~$67; FV $115 (+71% upside); 30.25% operating margin, ROIC ~3x WACC, fwd P/E 17.7 cheapest in years; largest position, interested in adding more at these levels; biggest risk is the shift to short-form content.
calls.base_case: Double-digit growth 2026-28 with pricing power and record margins.
calls.bull_case: Levers: re-report subscriber numbers, free ad-supported tier, own short-form product.
calls.bear_case: Structural shift to TikTok/Reels/Shorts erodes long-form viewing.
